final: WITH p AS (SELECT l.ID, pt.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS a, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS b FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, pt.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(a) AS a, AVG(b) AS b FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(b) AS mb FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.* FROM s, m WHERE s.b > m.mb) SELECT AVG(k.a) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(k.b) AS avg_aptt_pt, AVG(k.b) - (SELECT mb FROM m) AS excess FROM k
